title: Living-Relative Contact Log
dataSources: Tree records (`genealogy:record`), DNA matches (`dna:match`), ancestor events (`ancestor:event`), archive documents (`archive:document`), tree nodes (`familytree:node`).
app: Genealogy and family-history research — tree platforms (Ancestry, FamilySearch), DNA match exports (23andMe, MyHeritage), and document / archive catalogues — streamed to Splunk HEC via GEDCOM and CSV exports.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=genealogy:record type=interview
| stats max(_time) as last_contact by relative
| eval months_since=round((now()-last_contact)/2629800,1)
| where months_since>12
| sort - months_since
description: Tracks when you last interviewed each living relative for their memories and nudges you before those stories are lost.
value: Older relatives hold irreplaceable memories; a gentle reminder ensures you capture them in time.
implementation: Ingest interview logs into `index=personal`; flag relatives not spoken to recently.
visualization: Table of relatives by time since last interview.
grandmaExplanation: It reminds you when you last recorded a relative's memories, so those precious stories are captured in time.
